description: Hi! I'm Sofia, a software developer (C#/.NET, Blazor, 5 years). I'd like to build a working web app for astronaut health on long missions, focused on what the crew can do when Earth is minutes away. I'm looking for: a designer (UI/slides), someone good at presenting/storytelling, and anyone who likes space science or health data. Beginners welcome! We'll work in Greek or English.
